acceptance: Red test first: one launch with 6 dropped variables emits 1 INFO record naming 6, and no WARN.
A cell-caused I2 violation is still WARN.
fix: At enforce, a launcher variable outside the allowlist is dropped and recorded once per launch as an INFO summary with the dropped names. Keep WARN for a violation that a cell causes (a nested launch, a leak into a child).
source: console, 2026-10-27, operator "investigate in watcher issue"; wave-145 errors channel 10:05Z-12:40Z (1387 WARN signals)
summary: Wave 145 wrote 836 ISOLATION_I2_VIOLATION WARN signals in 2.5 h, for example TERM_PROGRAM, XPC_SERVICE_NAME, TAVILY_API_KEY dropped from the claude-tmux router launch (source launcher, action refused, stage enforce). The drop is the intended I2 behavior, but the WARNs flood the errors channel (60% of all WARN), so a watcher cannot use severity>=WARN.
title: An I2 launcher variable that is dropped at enforce is one INFO summary per launch, not a WARN per variable
